{{Quote|Geological yellow concave released poisonous gases on this world, posing biological hazards and interfering with data transmission.|Dendotaloga-K|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Dendotaloga-K''' was a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] research [[Droid/Legends|droid]] dispatched by the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Gray Secant]]'' to study the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]]. Accompanied by a squad of Gree battle droids, it observed the [[Quake]], but the gases released into its atmosphere prevented it from transmitting data&mdash;and according to its calculations, the atmosphere would not be clear again for approximately ten thousand years by the time of the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />
